description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerReviewer class, representing a reviewer entity associated with performance tracking in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for reviewer ID, date added, status, and relations to PerformanceTracker and Employee entities, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewer
classes.description: An entity class representing a reviewer of a performance tracker, with properties for IDs, related entities, and timestamps, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer record.

methods.name: getReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee entity representing the reviewer.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Assigns the Employee entity as the reviewer.

methods.name: setPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Associates a PerformanceTracker entity with this reviewer.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Gets the date when the reviewer was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the reviewer was added.
